# OpenAI Dart Client

> Dart client for the OpenAI API with Responses API, Decisions API, Chat Completions, images, videos, audio, custom tools, embeddings, evals, realtime, and more.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/README.md) (~9.8k tokens): Primary package documentation with installation, configuration, and usage examples.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/CHANGELOG.md) (~21.7k tokens): Release history and version-by-version changes.
- [MIGRATION](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/MIGRATION.md) (~15.7k tokens): Upgrade notes and breaking-change guidance.

## Examples

- [decisions_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/decisions_example.dart) (~639 tokens): Typed Decisions questions, refusals, usage, and inline images.
- [containers_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/containers_example.dart) (~1.5k tokens): Container memory/network configuration, Code Interpreter IDs, and files.
- [responses_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/responses_example.dart) (~870 tokens): Responses API with built-in tools.
- [async_tools_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/async_tools_example.dart) (~1.3k tokens): Local async function/custom jobs, original call IDs and latest-response continuation.
- [configuration_updates_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/configuration_updates_example.dart) (~1.2k tokens): Local persistent reasoning effort updates with stable request-level effort and typed conversation items.
- [prompt_cache_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/prompt_cache_example.dart) (~723 tokens): Responses prewarming, comparison diagnostics, and narrow Chat cache options.
- [chat_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/chat_example.dart) (~461 tokens): Chat completions, multi-turn conversations, and legacy cache retention.
- [chat_audio_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/chat_audio_example.dart) (~767 tokens): Chat audio output, ID-only replay, and partial stream accumulation.
- [streaming_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/streaming_example.dart) (~760 tokens): Content streaming, detailed final usage, and obfuscation controls.
- [tool_calling_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/tool_calling_example.dart) (~742 tokens): Function calling with tool definitions.
- [vision_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/vision_example.dart) (~838 tokens): Image analysis with vision models.
- [embeddings_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/embeddings_example.dart) (~837 tokens): Text embeddings with dimension control.
- [images_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/images_example.dart) (~1.2k tokens): GPT Image generation.
- [image_model_selection_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/image_model_selection_example.dart) (~554 tokens): Local generation/multipart/JSON-edit model contracts without API calls.
- [audio_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/audio_example.dart) (~1k tokens): Text-to-speech and transcription.
- [realtime_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/realtime_example.dart) (~1.9k tokens): Realtime API (WebSocket and WebRTC).
- [videos_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/videos_example.dart) (~1.6k tokens): Sora video generation, editing, and extension.
- [files_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/files_example.dart) (~1.1k tokens): File upload and management.
- [fine_tuning_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/fine_tuning_example.dart) (~1.7k tokens): Fine-tuning job management.
- [batches_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/batches_example.dart) (~1.5k tokens): Batch processing for async jobs.
- [evals_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/evals_example.dart) (~1.7k tokens): Model evaluation and testing.
- [moderation_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/moderation_example.dart) (~1.3k tokens): Content moderation.
- [content_provenance_checks_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/content_provenance_checks_example.dart) (~570 tokens): Content provenance (C2PA/SynthID) detection.
- [error_handling_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/error_handling_example.dart) (~1.3k tokens): Exception handling patterns.
- [retry_guidance_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/retry_guidance_example.dart) (~696 tokens): Local transient, permanent-quota, and long-hint scenarios without API calls.
- [conversations_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/conversations_example.dart) (~1.5k tokens): Conversations API for state management.
- [chatkit_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/chatkit_example.dart) (~1.9k tokens): ChatKit sessions and threads.
- [assistants_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/assistants_example.dart) (~1.3k tokens): Assistants API (deprecated).
- [models_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/models_example.dart) (~780 tokens): Model listing and retrieval.
- [web_search_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/web_search_example.dart) (~1.1k tokens): Web search with Responses API.
- [web_search_controls_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/web_search_controls_example.dart) (~1.2k tokens): Local GA filtered/image search, sources, future results, and REST/SSE parsing without API calls.
- [completions_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/completions_example.dart) (~327 tokens): Legacy completions API.
- [uploads_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/uploads_example.dart) (~387 tokens): Large file multipart uploads.
- [skills_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/skills_example.dart) (~346 tokens): Skills management.
- [input_tokens_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/input_tokens_example.dart) (~487 tokens): Input token counting.
- [openai_dart_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/openai_dart/example/openai_dart_example.dart) (~577 tokens): Quick-start overview.
